title: A car across the footpath
description: Two walkers detour into the road around a car that blocks the pavement.

title: Shop goods leave no walking room
description: A pedestrian steps into the road to pass crates, sacks and a display table.

title: A motorcycle blocks the route
description: A walker steps around a motorcycle’s front wheel and returns to the footpath.

title: Bicycles across the pavement
description: A walker leaves the footpath to pass the protruding bicycle wheels.
